objective: Reduce proven filtered lexical/hybrid query scratch requested-byte peak while preserving exact results and rare/hot latency.
method: Profile source allocation stages in an isolated baseline archive before production edits; profiling times are not performance evidence.
Reuse exact inherited retrieval probe workload, System counting allocator and exhaustive oracle; compare complete ordered payloads across revisions and rounds.
Freeze candidate source commit before build. Bind source, probe, harness, plan, executable and raw report hashes; no automatic retries.
Run five alternating process rounds serially only in root-approved quiet window after unrelated builds/tests stop.
Compare sorted-address and compact-offset owner membership in one frozen three-variant study; alternate and reverse orders across five rounds.
acceptance: All exhaustive per-query and complete cross-revision ordered-result payload comparisons match, including floating-point scores.
Rare-query median requested-byte peak decreases in both initial and updated phases; retain cold first-query peaks and persistent scratch limits.
No sustained >5% p50 or empirical p99 regression in either rare or hot group versus baseline.
Retain unfavorable observations and failures; no weakening query limits, ownership, text scrub/error handling, or scoring semantics.
sustained_regression_rule: Median current round quantile exceeds baseline median by over 5%, and at least four of five paired rounds are slower; descriptive investigation trigger, not statistical significance.
limits: Free local synthetic development only; no paid API/cloud/models.
Requested-byte accounting excludes allocator internal storage and process RSS. The probe uses one worker; no production or population-tail guarantee.
Historical timing comparison remains the separate retained study; this study compares current main to one scoped optimization.

candidate_designs.sorted: Reuse document-reference Vec storage for sorted exact owner addresses after dropping slot mask.
candidate_designs.current: Use exact u32 owner-address offsets in existing FastSet, with checked full-width fallback; drop slot mask first.

selection_rule: Require correctness and lower rare-query median requested-byte peaks, and no sustained >5% p50/p99 regression in all four groups. Among qualifying candidates prefer the lower rare-query peak; retain all candidate observations even if rejected.
